events.title: U.S. Leading Economic Index Unexpectedly Falls In October Amid Fewer Building Permits
events.description: A report released by the Conference Board on Thursday showed an unexpected decrease by its reading on leading U.S. economic indicators in the month of October. The Conference Board said its leading economic index fell by 0.3 percent in October after coming in unchanged in September. Economists had expected the index to remain unchanged for the second straight month.

events.title: Philly Fed Index Plunges To Six-Month Low In November
events.description: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia released a report on Thursday showing regional manufacturing was less widespread in the month of November but continued to expand overall. The Philly Fed said its diffusion index for current general activity plunged to 6.3 in November after tumbling to 20.9 in October.

events.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Inch Up To Two-Month High
events.description: First-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly higher in the week ended November 14th, according to a report released by the Labor Department on Thursday. The report said initial jobless claims inched up to 203,000, an increase of 1,000 from the previous week's revised level of 202,000. Economists had expected jobless claims to slip to 198,000.

events.title: Walmart Q3 Net Profit Drops, Despite Sales Growth; Lifts FY27 Outlook
events.description: Retail giant Walmart Inc. reported Thursday lower profit in its third quarter of fiscal 2027, mainly on the absence of prior year's significant gain on equity, while operating income climbed with growth in U.S. comparable sales and eCommerce performance. Meanwhile, U.S. comparable sales growth was slower than last year. Further, the company lifted fiscal 2027 forecast again.

events.title: Bay Street Headed For Positive Start
events.description: Higher Canadian and U.S. futures point to a firm start for the Canadian market Thursday morning. Tech stocks are seen moving higher amid renewed optimism about AI trade following Anthropic's record IPO offering.

events.title: Philly Fed Index Plunges Much More Than Expected In November

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Inch Higher
events.description: First-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly higher in the week ended November 14th, according to a report released by the Labor Department on Thursday.

events.title: Euro Rises As Risk-Appetite Improves
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as European stocks edged higher after three days of losses. Technology stocks were rising after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record.

events.title: Euro Rises Against Majors
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Hovers Near 6-Week Lows On Consumer Sector Decline
events.description: The FTSE 100 dropped to 10,524.60, down 0.25%, as consumer sector losses offset gains elsewhere. Investec fell 6.6% and JD Sports Fashion dropped 4.2% after cutting profit guidance. Mulberry plunged 22% despite turnaround progress.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as European stocks traded higher after three days of losses. Technology stocks were rising after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record.

events.title: Indian Shares Rebound Led By Auto And Bank Stocks
events.description: Indian shares rebounded sharply on Thursday after falling notably in the previous session due to profit taking after recent string of gains.

events.title: French Stock Market Climbs On Tech, Finance Gains
events.description: France's CAC 40 index rose 0.26% to 8,167.90 Thursday, rebounding after three consecutive days of losses. Technology stocks led gains following Anthropic's record $81.3 billion IPO. STMicroElectronics surged over 4.5%, while Soitec soared 15% after announcing 40% annual revenue growth targets.
